### Affected Version

v1.1.1

### Describe the Bug

When opening a very large `XTC` or `XTH` file (in my case , over 6000 pages XTH), will run out of available heap during load or page rendering. In the less severe case, shows memory error on page rendering. In the more severe case, memory pressure triggers a crash and the device reboots in loop.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Copy a very large `XTC` or `XTH` ebook (over 6000 Pages) to the device/SD card.
2. Open the book
3. It will show memory error or just reboot

### Expected Behavior

Large `XTC` and `XTH` files should open reliably without exhausting memory. If the file is too large to process safely, the reader should fail gracefully with a clear error message and return to a stable screen, without crashing, rebooting, or entering a boot loop.
